title: Foreign currency member pickup
purpose: Provide a consistent, secure process for handing over foreign currency orders to members.

when_to_use: A member arrives at the branch to collect their foreign currency order.

procedures.title: Verify the member and order
procedures.purpose: Confirm the order is ready and the member is authorized to collect it.

steps.instruction: Ask the member for a valid government-issued photo ID.
Locate the order in the currency ordering system.
Match the member’s details to the order confirmation.

decisions.condition: The member’s details do not match the order
decisions.result: Pause the pickup and contact the branch manager.

notes: Keep the order reference available throughout the pickup process.

procedures.title: Complete the pickup

steps.instruction: Count the currency with the member.
Record the collection and provide a receipt.

warnings: Do not release currency until identity verification is complete.
procedures.expectedResult: The member receives their order and the collection is recorded.
